items.title: Swagger Editor App
items.description: Swagger Editor App is a full-featured tool for working with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, combining a visual editor and a flexible REST client in a single application. It allows developers and QA engineers to design, validate, and instantly test APIs using a server-side proxy to bypass CORS limitations.
role: Developed the App Header — a responsive component with dynamic navigation: unauthenticated users see 'Sign In' and 'Sign Up' buttons, authenticated users see 'History' and 'Sign Out'
Implemented private route protection — expired or invalid tokens redirect users to the main page
Built the Swagger Editor with support for loading and pasting OpenAPI schemas in JSON and YAML formats, auto-detection of format, and switching between formats with conversion
Added schema validation with visual error indication
Integrated schema saving for authenticated users — the schema is automatically restored in the editor on the next login
Added language switching (EN/RU)
Configured private route protection and error handling
Created a custom 404 page

Conducted code reviews for colleagues

items.title: Tandem - SPA Application
items.description: Tandem is a project that prepares you for a technical interview for a Frontend Developer role. It includes an AI assistant that helps you get ready for the interview, along with widgets where you can practice, and a knowledge library where you can study the material. You can also earn points and compete with developers from around the world.
role: Designed and developed the landing page — introduced the app's functionality and features with responsive layouts and animations
Built the Console widget — an interactive drag-and-drop exercise where users arrange console outputs in the correct order. Implemented answer validation logic and real-time feedback

Developed the points system — a two-part component including points displayed in the sidebar and a progress snail visual indicator showing interview readiness based on completed mock interviews with the AI agent
Created the leaderboard table with server-side sorting by points
Made the interface fully responsive and cross-browser compatible
Set up global theming with support for light and dark modes
